proposals.title: Visual home
proposals.axis: Space: the robot in 3D and its cameras, every view sim vs real, a badge per device

proposals.title: Type catalog
proposals.axis: Device type: one standard block per sensor/actuator type; a robot is a list of typed devices

proposals.title: Gate matrix
proposals.axis: Acceptance: devices x gates, each cell a pass/fail you can open

proposals.title: Run inspector
proposals.axis: Time: pick a run from the tree, every channel real vs twin on one clock
proposals.question: What happened in this run?
